detached_structure.evidence: A wooden pergola or deck-like structure with slatted framing sits at the west side of the yellow outline, next to the house. It may be attached to the house rather than detached.

signals.notes: The house is heavily shaded by large trees on the east and south sides. A white vehicle sits on the paved strip at the north edge of the outline, and the roof is dark and partly shadowed, so condition is hard to judge.
